column1: # AUDIT04-E — THE PYTHON HALF, WHICH THIS MANIFEST DID NOT COVER.
# The header above says membership is DECLARED rather than discovered. That was
# true only of Wolfram: tools/check_test_manifest.sh scanned `-name '*.m'`, so
# the denominator was 85 .m files and 24 .py files under tests/ were declared by
# nothing. Three governance documents nevertheless stated the manifest covered
# They were also RUN by nothing. pytest.ini set `testpaths = tests/analysis`, and
# every pytest invocation in the Makefile and in CI names tests/analysis,
# index-deconvolution, or the four replication packages. On top of that the
# TSK-...-Test.py naming matches neither `test_*.py` nor `*_test.py`, so even
# pointing pytest at these directories collected ZERO.
# Each file was therefore RUN individually on 2026-09-07 to classify it by
# measurement rather than by reading it:
#      2 producer    scripts: report by exit code or write artefacts, 0 asserts
# The two RED files are NOT environment problems and are recorded as open items
# in GOVERNANCE/VERIFICATION.md rather than papered over. Quarantine here means
# "excluded on purpose, with the measured reason attached" -- never "passing".

HierarchyEncoder. WAS quarantined RED: test_pure_dag asserted a pure DAG costs 0 and measured 4.754887502163468 bits. RESOLVED 2026-09-07 (AUDIT04-F) as a MIS-STATED INVARIANT, not an encoder defect: feedback_edges is a count and is correctly 0, while hierarchy_cost is a DESCRIPTION LENGTH and cannot be 0 for a structured object. The value is exactly 3*log2(3) = n*log2(num_layers), derived from the cost model rather than copied from the output; the edge term vanishes because every block has max_edges=1 and log2(C(1,k))=0. 3 passed
